scope: source acquisition and structural validation, not semantic or scholarly validation
normalization: Remove HTML sup elements in full, strip remaining HTML tags, decode entities, collapse whitespace; do not change wording or punctuation.
translation_mapping_method: API array assigned by chapter metadata in canonical order; first/middle/last in each surah checked independently against keyed Quran.ai translation entries. This is a same-provider cross-interface check, not an independent text-critical witness.
tafsir_author: Jalal al-Din al-Mahalli and Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti
translation_variant_policy: Keep requested API resource20 as baseline; preserve other interface variants.
